import json
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path

controller = Path('/tmp/chess-nov09-fast-mate-futility-corpus.py').read_text()
exec(compile(controller[:controller.index('lines=[')], '<existing-idle-controller>', 'exec'))
prefix = '/tmp/chess-nov09-fast-mate-futility-regression-repeats'
cases = [96, 103]
records = []
for index in cases:
    original = json.loads(Path(f'/tmp/chess-nov09-mate-futility-corpus-{index}-pair.json').read_text())
    for repeat in range(3):
        checkpoint = Path(f'{prefix}-{index}-{repeat}.json')
        if checkpoint.exists():
            pair = json.loads(checkpoint.read_text())
            assert pair['binarySha256'] == expected and pair['line'] == original['line']
            records.append(pair)
            continue
        while True:
            wait_idle()
            assert all(digest(binaries[side]) == expected[side] for side in binaries)
            fenfile = Path(prefix + '-one-fen.txt')
            fenfile.write_text(original['line'] + '\n')
            pair = {'index': index, 'repeat': repeat, 'line': original['line'], 'binarySha256': expected}
            interrupted = False
            for side in (['before', 'after'] if repeat % 2 == 0 else ['after', 'before']):
                path = f'{prefix}-{index}-{repeat}-{side}'
                with open(path + '.txt', 'w') as out:
                    result = subprocess.run(['python3', '/tmp/chess-oct10-idle-run.py', binaries[side], 'abdada-bench', '--fens', str(fenfile), '--think-ms', str(6000 if index >= 94 else 1200), '--threads', '4', '--runs', '1', '--json', path + '.json'], stdout=out, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
                if result.returncode in (75, 130):
                    interrupted = True
                    print('Excluded interrupted pair', index, repeat, side, flush=True)
                    break
                if result.returncode:
                    raise RuntimeError(f'Benchmark failed {index} {repeat} {side}: {result.returncode}')
                pair[side] = json.loads(Path(path + '.json').read_text())['positions'][0]
            if interrupted:
                continue
            checkpoint.write_text(json.dumps(pair, indent=2) + '\n')
            records.append(pair)
            print('Completed', index, repeat, *[(side, pair[side]['threads'][0]['summary']['move'], pair[side]['threads'][0]['summary']['depth']) for side in binaries], flush=True)
            break
for side in binaries:
    Path(prefix + '-' + side + '.json').write_text(json.dumps({'binarySha256': expected, 'positions': [r[side] for r in records]}, indent=2) + '\n')
while True:
    wait_idle()
    with open(prefix + '-common.txt', 'w') as out:
        result = subprocess.run(['python3', '/tmp/chess-oct10-idle-run.py', 'python3', '/tmp/chess-nov09-common-rescore.py', prefix + '-before.json', prefix + '-after.json', prefix + '-common.json'], stdout=out, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
    if result.returncode in (75, 130):
        continue
    if result.returncode:
        raise RuntimeError('Common referee failed')
    break
rows = json.loads(Path(prefix + '-common.json').read_text())
for index in cases:
    group = [r for r, pair in zip(rows, records) if pair['index'] == index]
    print('CASE', index, json.dumps({side: {'moves': [r[side] for r in group], 'depths': [r[side + 'Depth'] for r in group], 'losses': [r[side + 'Loss'] for r in group]} for side in binaries}), flush=True)

import datetime
import hashlib
import json
import os
import shutil
import signal
import subprocess
import tempfile
import time
import urllib.request
from pathlib import Path

root = Path('/home/vadim/code/GolangChessAI')
old_pid = 3711170
candidate = Path('/tmp/chess-nov09-fast-mate-futility')
backup = Path('/tmp/chess-nov09-baseline-before-fast-mate')
archive = json.loads((root / 'testdata/strength_2026_11_09_fast_mating_futility_validation.json').read_text())
expected = archive['binarySha256']
digest = lambda p: hashlib.sha256(Path(p).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
assert digest(root / 'main') == digest(f'/proc/{old_pid}/exe') == expected['before']
assert digest(candidate) == expected['after']
patch = subprocess.run(['git', 'diff', '--', 'pkg/chessai/board/fast_check.go', 'pkg/chessai/player/ai/abdada.go', 'pkg/chessai/player/ai/abdada_regression_test.go'], cwd=root, capture_output=True, text=True, check=True).stdout
assert patch == archive['trackedSourcePatch']
assert (root / 'pkg/chessai/board/mating_move_test.go').read_text() == archive['newBoardTestSource']
for name in ['conf.json', 'game_conf.json']:
    json.loads((root / name).read_text())
summary = json.loads(Path('/tmp/chess-nov09-fast-mate-futility-corpus-summary.json').read_text())
assert summary['metadata']['binarySha256'] == expected
metrics = summary['summary']['all104']
assert metrics['after']['cappedMeanLoss1000'] < metrics['before']['cappedMeanLoss1000']
assert metrics['after']['lossAtLeast200'] < metrics['before']['lossAtLeast200']
assert metrics['after']['mateScaleLosses'] < metrics['before']['mateScaleLosses']
env = {}
for item in Path(f'/proc/{old_pid}/environ').read_bytes().split(b'\0'):
    if b'=' in item:
        key, value = item.split(b'=', 1)
        env[os.fsdecode(key)] = os.fsdecode(value)

def account(path):
    request = urllib.request.Request('https://lichess.org' + path, headers={'Authorization': 'Bearer ' + env['LICHESS_TOKEN']})
    with urllib.request.urlopen(request, timeout=10) as response:
        return json.load(response)

def require_idle():
    if account('/api/account/playing')['nowPlaying']:
        print('Deferred: active game; existing bot untouched.', flush=True)
        raise SystemExit(75)

require_idle()
if backup.exists():
    assert digest(backup) == expected['before']
else:
    shutil.copy2(root / 'main', backup)
assert digest(backup) == expected['before']
fd, stage_name = tempfile.mkstemp(prefix='.main-fast-mate-', dir=root)
os.close(fd)
stage = Path(stage_name)
try:
    shutil.copy2(candidate, stage)
    assert digest(stage) == expected['after']
    require_idle()
    assert digest(f'/proc/{old_pid}/exe') == expected['before']
    log_path = Path('/tmp/chess.lichess.log')
    log_offset = log_path.stat().st_size
    os.kill(old_pid, signal.SIGTERM)
    for _ in range(100):
        if not Path(f'/proc/{old_pid}/exe').exists():
            break
        time.sleep(.05)
    else:
        raise RuntimeError('Original bot did not stop; no replacement launched.')
    stage.replace(root / 'main')
    with log_path.open('ab', buffering=0) as log:
        child = subprocess.Popen([str(root / 'main'), 'lichess'], cwd=root, env=env, stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL, stdout=log, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT, start_new_session=True)
    time.sleep(3)
    if child.poll() is not None:
        shutil.copy2(backup, stage)
        stage.replace(root / 'main')
        with log_path.open('ab', buffering=0) as log:
            restored = subprocess.Popen([str(root / 'main'), 'lichess'], cwd=root, env=env, stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL, stdout=log, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT, start_new_session=True)
        raise RuntimeError(f'Candidate exited; restored original bot as PID {restored.pid}.')
    assert digest(f'/proc/{child.pid}/exe') == digest(root / 'main') == expected['after']
    assert Path(f'/proc/{child.pid}/cwd').readlink() == root
    user = account('/api/account')
    assert user['id'] == 'vadbot'
    record = {
        'deployedAt': datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),
        'oldPid': old_pid, 'newPid': child.pid,
        'binarySha256': expected['after'], 'baselineBackup': str(backup),
        'baselineSha256': expected['before'], 'logOffset': log_offset,
        'authenticatedAccount': user['id'], 'ratingsBeforeCandidateGames': user['perfs'],
        'nowPlaying': [{'gameId': g['gameId'], 'color': g['color']} for g in account('/api/account/playing')['nowPlaying']],
        'webServerPid': 3671326, 'webServerStillRunning': Path('/proc/3671326/exe').exists(),
        'status': 'Candidate installed and single replacement started; natural-game validation pending; no Elo gain claimed.',
    }
    Path('/tmp/chess-nov09-fast-mate-deployment.json').write_text(json.dumps(record, indent=2) + '\n')
    for path, old, new in [('/tmp/chess-oct10-idle-run.py', f'bot_pid={old_pid}', f'bot_pid={child.pid}'), ('/tmp/chess-nov09-runtime-status.py', f'bot_pid = {old_pid}', f'bot_pid = {child.pid}')]:
        p = Path(path)
        text = p.read_text()
        assert old in text
        p.write_text(text.replace(old, new))
    print(json.dumps({k: record[k] for k in ['deployedAt', 'oldPid', 'newPid', 'binarySha256', 'baselineBackup', 'authenticatedAccount', 'nowPlaying', 'webServerStillRunning', 'status']}, indent=2))
finally:
    if stage.exists():
        stage.unlink()
